batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c D Padikkal b Suyash Sharma

batting.name: JC Buttler
batting.dismissal: c JR Hazlewood b B Kumar

batting.name: JG Bethell
batting.dismissal: c M Shahrukh Khan b Mohammed Siraj

batting.name: RM Patidar
batting.dismissal: c Washington Sundar b MJ Suthar

batting.name: JM Sharma
batting.dismissal: c MJ Suthar b Rashid Khan

balls.text: Full toss outside off and Washington can't get a hold of this. Hit to long-on on the bounce and Gujarat Titans finish on 205 for 3
Now Krunal goes for his trusted bouncer. It's been hit for a six today by Sai Sudharsan, but Holder can only pull it out to deep midwicket on the bounce. That was fired in at 117kph!
Full toss outside off, driven wide of long-off and Padikkal is sloppy and allows a boundary! It goes on the practice pitches, but Padikkal got there but just doesn't get down properly
This is in the slot and Holder picks the bones out of this one as he slogs this over deep midwicket. Deep into the stands!
Great comeback from Krunal. Bowls a 108kph wide yorker, and keeps it just inside his line as Holder leaves it expecting a wide
And Holder connects well! Krunal has slung this low and flat and quick at 110kph, and Holder just clears his front leg and heaves this over cow corner

More runs through poor fielding! This is a lovely yorker outside leg. Washington ends up with a French cut to short fine leg where Bhuvneshwar lets it go through him. But he runs back to prevent the boundary and save two runs. No boundaries in the 17th, 18th or 19th overs!
Lovely wide yorker. Holder can only squeeze this down to long-off
A rare misfield from Patidar today. Low full toss outside off, Holder hits this to cover but Patidar is not able to collect it and it deflects wide of long-off. GT pick up a couple of runs
Banged in short outside off at 132kph, he has a swipe at it but can't connect
Hazlewood goes for another yorker. This time on the stumps. Not quite full enough. Flicked away through square leg and they manage two
Full around middle and leg, driven down to long-off

Looks to pull away this short ball and miscues it completely. Washington is lucky it doesn't carry to Shepherd at deep square leg. Just nine runs and a wicket across the last two overs! Bhuvneshwar closes out his spell oh so well
Yorker outside off first up, squeezed out to deep point

And that's gone to short third! Bhuvneshwar went for the yorker and Buttler went for the reverse-scoop. But he can't quite get under it and force the pace. No elevation at all and that's straight down Hazlewood's throat at short third. RCB pulling things back very well here
Short and angled across, pulled away to deep midwicket's right. Only a single
Bhuvneshwar using all his experience and craft here. Buttler backs away and he follows him with a yorker outside leg. Buttler can only squeeze it out square on the off side for a single
On a length on leg, steered to short third for a quick single
Dropped short outside off, Buttler slaps it to Patidar's left at cover, but the RCB skipper has been near impossible to get past today. Keeps this down to a four-run over!
On a length outside off, Washington can only punch it down to long-off
Tossed up full and drifting away to pitch on off, eased to point
Full on leg, Buttler danced down and can only flick it to long-on's right. Kohli's too quick to let the batters get a second
Googly on a length on leg, Washington flicks this towards deep midwicket
Full on leg, Buttler eases this through midwicket

Tim David's best efforts are not enough! Washington off to a flyer here! Back of length delivery angled across him, he stands tall and punches this square. Beats the point fielder and David running to his left can't stop it with a dive
Oh, shot! That's in the slot around leg and Washington stays still and lofts this over cow corner
On a length around leg, Washi clips it to midwicket

And that's the end of Sudharsan's knock! Hazlewood uses pace and bounce to end a solid knock. 143kph back of length delivery hurries Sudharsan, who is late into the shot and it goes off the toe end back to Hazlewood, who takes a simple catch
balls.dismissal: B Sai Sudharsan — caught and bowled

balls.text: Extra bounce on this length ball squares Buttler up a bit as he fends at it. Gets an outside edge that goes to short third on the bounce
Buttler wins round 1! Goes for the wide yorker, is just a little short, and that's enough for Buttler to pounce on it, opening the face to drill it away through point
On a length on middle, tucked through midwicket
Suyash bowls a googly but right in the slot and that's easy pickings for Buttler. Clears his front leg and swings it over long-on

And there it is. A third IPL century for Sai Sudharsan! He's not had the best start to the season, but he's announced his arrival now. He's stood up and driven GT's efforts today after being put in to bat. A century off 57 balls. Slaps away a length ball through cover point to bring up the milestone
Tossed full on leg, whipped away through midwicket
Just a tad short outside off and Buttler crunches it away off the back foot through cover
Googly on a length on off, cut away through point and gets a single to move to 99
Full and wide, driven out to deep point
Full outside off and angling in, eased down the ground
Banged in short on leg and angled across, cut away on the bounce to deep point
Low full toss punished as it should be. Sudharsan whips this yorker-gone-wrong away over midwicket. Beats the fielder in the deep to his left
Full on off, driven down to long-on
Full on the pads, eased towards long-on and they nick two
Flicked in front of square and just a single. A good over for RCB. A good comeback by Suyash after being hit for a six first ball
Full around middle and leg, Buttler just gets enough to glance it fine down the leg side and he picks up a couple of runs

And there's the breakthrough! Gill was trying to take on this short-ish ball, and swings hard at it. Doesn't get it off the middle and it's a simple catch for DDP at long-on. Suyash takes a bow in celebration as the GT captain walks off
Bowls it on a length outside off and takes it away from Sudharsan, who can only slash it away to deep cover

Hits this right back at the bowler and Suyash looks hurt. This was full outside off and Sudharsan hammers it right back. Suyash got his hands down to try and stop that and takes a blow on his fingertips on his left hand. Physio out for him

Overpitched, and punished. Sudharsan releases the pressure immediately after a quiet over. This was a googly, full on off and spinning away, but he leans forward to reach out and loft it over long-off
Full-ish outside off, driven out to deep point. Just five runs off the over. That was much needed for RCB
Very full outside off, Gill can only work it down to long-on
In the blockhole outside off, squeezed down to long-off
135kph wide yorker, Sudharsan squeezes it to cover's right and Patidar is quick to get to the abll, preventing a single
Back of length, pace off, Gill pulls it out to deep square leg
Slower ball, dipping and pitching very full outside off. Sudharsan drives to cover's right and Patidar flings himself at it to make a good stop
On a length on the pads, tucked to deep midwicket
Taps this length ball into the vacant midwicket region and that's an easy couple of runs
On a length outside off, cut away through point
Flung full on off, clipped through midwicket
Krunal pulls back his length and cramps Krunal for room. Tucked towards midwicket
Tossed up full and now it's Gill in on the fun! Massive slog sweep over backward square
On his knees and swipes this length ball away towards long leg! The ball sat up from a back of a line length, down leg, and Suds can manipulate the field too well to not find that gap
On a length with great loopy-ness on this one. Down to long-on
Full-ish and outside off, driven down to deep extra cover
On a length, bunted down to long-on
Strange ball! Angling down leg. Pitches and spins back in. But all of this happens behind his legs. Jitesh does well to connect
On a length, spinning away, flicked down to mid-wicket now
Back of a length outside off, dabbed down to deep cover

Fastest to 2000 runs in the IPL. What a way to get there. The ball sat up in the slot, right outside off. He gets down on one knee and lathers this one across the line. High elbow on that loft, and he's got it over cow corner
Now that's a ripper of its own! Spears this one in rapidly well outside off, spinning away and past Sudharsan looking to cut this and losing his balance instead
On a length at the pads, flicked towards deep square leg
On a length, on the stumps. Flicked away towards deep square leg

Sudharsan's timed the screws out of this bouncer! It's been an effective change-up ball for Krunal, but Suds steps onto the backfoot and sets it up with a late slice over deep backward point. If you expect it, loses a lot of the venom
On a length but speared in down leg. Time to reload
Looped up and on a length, attacking the stumps. Comfortable flick towards cow corner
On a length outside off. Now driven down to covers. For once, Gill keeping the strike for the next over!
Slower 'un outside off, and Gill swipes this into cow corner with his trademark pull! Was low and outside off. But Gill has all the skill in the world to stay still and middle this across the line
Pulls back the length slightly to a good length, angling away after landing on the stumps. Dapped down to deep third
Now he's laced a cracking drive through covers! Sits up in the slot outside off, so he can just stay still and drive it to the covers

Another one of those ridiculous Sudharsan scoops! He goes deeeep into the off stump. Shepherd follows him but it's a slot ball right in front of him. He scoops this over deep third.  Brings up an authoritative fifty
Back of a length outside off, Gill dabs this towards deep backward point
113.2 clicks, and just rushes past the flick here! Keeps low off a length, well outside off. Sudharsan crouches but can't get to this one
On a full-ish length on the pads, flicked down to backward square
Back of a length outside off. Driven towards covers
Goes for a short ball! But not the usual venom on this. Angles in from outside leg and past Sudharsan's helmet, but he flicks it away towards deep midwicket
On a length and drifting towards his pads. Flicked towards mid-wicket
Back of a length and moving back into him. On the back foot and flicked towards deep square leg
A slower 'un, back of the hand. On a length on the stumps, he dabs it towards short third

Sudharsan is liking the strike, and why not! Rasikh with another nothinburger well outside off, a little too full and with room. He plays a late cut while crouching at the crease. Runs down to deep backward point
Slower 'un just outside off, now Gill tries to pluck this across the line from under his eyes. Does not get under it, flicked towards mid-wicket. He throws his head back, missed out there, hethinks
He's looking to force the issue here. Length ball on the stumps. Gill is making up for lost time, ungainly charge down the pitch but holds his shape and gets it down to the vacant long-on

We've missed you, Gill! Hasn't timed this, though. The ball rose at his hips from back of a length. 133 clicks, so didn't bounce much. He swipes this beyond deep midwicket but not enough power to let it run to the ropes
Famine just yet... On a length outside off, moves back in. Defended towards point
Another cracking cut! The ball was outside off and gave too much room after jumping up from a good length. He cuts this late and with great power from his wrists. Down to deep backward point
On leg stump on a length, swinging back in on the pads. He flicks it towards square leg

And now he's cut this over deep backward point! Beautiful game awareness. Ball was back of a length and moving away to a seventh stump line. He just jumps on his feet and slashes this one over the ropes, no second chance needed
On a length outside off, now it's hit right back into the pitch. Flick gets only the bottom-edge here
Back of a length outside off. Misses the run down the pitch and that attempt at a drive. Jitesh bunts the ball back down to the non-striker

Just past the keeper! Batter shuffles into the off side, Hazlewood follows him with a length delivery. He goes for a late scoop while still on both legs, the ball travels just pass Jitesh and down to the ropes
On a length, a little too full, and angling away outside off once more. Driven down to deep extra cover
Back of a length but does not rise much, in that off-stump channel. Dabs this towards covers
Another cracking drive, but the ball is just a little fuller. Still outside off and there to be cut, but finds deep point
Nothing goofy about this cut! Sat up well outside off, back of a length and just 132.6 clicks. Innocuous ball absolutely smashed down to deep point

Where's that come out of? The ball was back of a length, angling away from outside off. Sudharsan gets on top of the bounce and reaches away from his body, flicks this towards deep covers. One hand comes off the handle to make the shot look a little goofy, but it was well-timed
Rasikh begins with a full ball outside off, angled away from the left-hander. Driven down to extra cover
On a length and angled into the stumps. Flicked towards deep square leg
Now he ventures down the pitch! But can only dab it back to the bowler. Was back of a length, maybe pulled back because he saw the batter coming. Keeps it on the stumps line once more

Punches this towards deep cover! Whaddashot, he rose at this ball outside off, swinging away from him but with just enough bounce on this to get on top of the ball. He jumped and got it through the covers cordon
On a length but attacking the pads on leg stump once more. Flicked towards square leg once more
Full-ish and on leg stump. Swinging back in. Dabs this flick towards square leg
Smart dab splits the cordon! Between third slip and gully. That tempting length ball, on the stumps and angled away. Reads the line early
Now he strays down the leg side line again. Extra bounce thuds into his pads, dribbles away to square leg. His flick would have taken the ball there anyway, he'll be happy with the leg bye
Looking to force the issue... but not too well... Outside off once more, looks to drive this length ball down the covers. But inside edge down into the pads. He was standing outside the crease
And now a lovely shape away from the left-hander! Length outside off, angling away even further. Moves away from the outside edge of this dab due to the extra bounce
On a good length, full-blooded flick swashes at air. For the best, if you're the batter, because it's too down leg. Time to reload
Back of a length, rising at his chest. He jumps at this and hoicks this towards deep square leg
Full-ish outside off, moving away now. Goes for a big cut but can only waft at air

Bangs this into his pads straight away! The ball is back of a length on the leg stump line. Thuds into his pads, rushing past Sudharsan's flick. Medium-sized appeal but they knew it was pitching outside leg
Now it's speared in full outside off, Sudharsan goes for a cheeky dab into the pitch. Ball runs down to point and he takes off for a run
Full on the pads down leg, angling back in. Flicked down to square leg

And now a lucky edge runs down to deep backward point! The ball was full-ish and well outside off, enticing that drive. He looks to play this away from his body and gets the outside edge, runs down the rapid outfield
Pushed closer to the off stump, moving into Gill. He punches this drive towards long-on
Good swing from Bhuvi here! Tempting well outside off, moves back in late. Enough room for Gill to dab a drive towards the covers
On a length and swinging away from the left-hander. Late glide towards deep backward point

And there it is, RCB win with seven balls to spare. Bouncer outside leg and Pandya just helps it along fine on the leg side for a single that does the job. And RCB finish off the Bengaluru leg in style, with four wins in five games, making amends for their poor home form last year
Scores are level! Banged in short and Krunal is onto it in a flash. Swatted away in front of square leg for a boundary
Full outside off, David is still a bit scratchy as he tries to swing this away. His bottom hand goes off the bat as the ball dribbles out to deep midwicket
Short on leg, pulled away to deep square leg
Slower bouncer angled across, Krunal goes across and looks to ramp it but can't connect
Suthar bowls another yorker, this time around off stump, and Krunal digs it out into the vacant midwicket region
And Krunal goes big again and clears the ropes again! This isn't overpitched as Suthar tries to bowl it across Krunal, who reaches out and swings it over midwicket anyway
Looks for a leg-stump yorker. Krunal manages to adjust and keep this out
Goes full and wide again, slapped to cover
Krunal is taking on the match-up! This is full and wide, but Krunal fetches it from a long way out and sweeps this flat and hard through midwicket
Oh, take that says Krunal. Full outside off. he gets a stride forward and hammers it down the ground. One-bounce four

On a length outside off and David is beaten on the outside edge. Rabada has bowled a very good over here, and should have had a wicket, but instead that ends up being a six and RCB pick up nine off it

And is that another one? No, it's flown beyond deep third! 143kph full ball and David looks to whip it leg side. He's completely undone and gets a leading edge that looked for the longest time like a catch at deep third, but it's gone for six! David won't mind the outcome, in the end
Fired in short outside off, David pulls out of an attempted shot. Called wide on height
Now David nearly swings himself off his feet here on this length ball outside off. Beaten by the pace again. This one was 148kph!
Back of length around off at 143kph, David looks to help it along fine on the leg side but is a tad late on the shot. Cops a body blow around his waist. Shows no discomfort though
Back of length delivery angled across at 146.5kph, Krunal opens the blade to guide it to deep third
David runs this length ball down to deep third
On a length around middle and off, cut away to deep cover
On a length around middle and leg, spinning away. Punched to cover
On a length around leg, tucked through square leg

Oh no, that's gone high in the air and Washington settles under it at cover! This is full on leg and Patidar looks to swing it down the ground. Skies it off the outside half of the bat and Suthar gets a big, big wicket - his first in the IPL! Washington makes some amends for that first-over drop. Can GT now amp up the pressure?
Drilled away through point
A bit short outside off, slapped away to deep cover
Oh, what a catch at cover by Suthar! This match is far from over! On a length outside off and Jitesh looks to slap it away. But it's too close to Suthar who takes a good catch diving to his left
Much better from Rashid. Tossed up full, but not overpitched, and it spins away as Jitesh has a swing down the ground again

And now Jitesh joins in on the fun! That is massive! He has struggled this season, but look at him today! This is flighted but too full and he swings through the line and sends it straight of long-off
Googly outside off, Jitesh with a forward defensive

Goes on the attack again but doesn't connect. This is a little shorter and Patidar doesn't quite get to the pitch of it, skipping down the track. Ends up flicking it out to deep midwicket on the bounce
And there goes Patidar! Floated full and Patidar gets a stride forward and lauonches it down the ground over long-off. There was a fielder there, but it goes well over him
Takes on the bouncer and pulls it away wide of long-on! Dug in short outside off and Jitesh swats it away down the ground. One bounce and four
On a length outside off, punches it back to the bowler

And now Kohli chops on! Short and wide, Kohli looks for the pull but gets a thick inside edge on this slower bouncer and hears the death rattle. Kohli walks off to great applause, but he won't be happy at getting out there
Oh, glorious! Kohli takes a step leg-side, and gets one step forward and lofts it down the ground, straight of long-off
And that's Kohli at his regal best! Dances out to this full ball, turning it into a half-volley, and whips this over deep midwicket. He was impressed with himself there!
On a length outside off, Kohli hangs back and blocks
Kohli takes a step out early and Holder ends up sliding a full ball down leg
Wrong'un on a length outside off, Patidar blocks it out to the off side

Oh, Rashid Khan shows why he's rated as highly as he is! A sensational knock from Padikkal comes to an end. It's the googly from around the wicket, and Padikkal plays down the wrong line as he skips out of his crease. The ball spins away past the outside edge and dislodges the off-bail
On a length outside off, punched down the ground to long-off
On a length around leg, tucked away through square leg
Full outside off, drills it to long-off
Kohli beats long-off! This is tossed up outside off and Kohli gets to the pitch of it and lofts it down the ground and straight of long-off running to his right. Good use of his feet by Kohli
Full down leg, Padikkal has a whip, but misses. This flicks the pads on the way to the keeper. A quiet over, just three off it
Full outside off, tucked away through square leg
Slower ball yorker on off, Kohli blocks it out
Banged in short, Padikkal jumps to ride the bounce and pulls it out to deep square leg
Padikkal shuffles across and Holder bowls a back of length delivery at 135kph going across him, but cramping him for the pull shot
Back of length outside off, Kohli hits a grounded pull to deep midwicket
Back of length outside off, dabbed to deep third
Oh, that's even more wristy from Kohli! Rabada overpitches again and Kohli stands still and flicks this over midwicket. 100-run stand up in 47 balls
Kohli will have those for breakfast, lunch and dinner! 147kph, full and too straight and Kohli flicks this away using those powerful wrists through backward square leg
Banged in short outside off and Kohli is beaten on the pull
Pushes this length ball to mid-off and they get a quick single
Looks to pull away a short ball and gets an inside edge square on the leg side. 30-ball fifty now for Virat Kohli.
On a length and spinning away. Kohli mistimes this drive, but goes down to covers anyway
On a length, pulled towards backward square on the backfoot

A 20-ball half-century, and Padikkal's unstoppable right now! Was in the slot once more, right in front of the stumps. He gets down on one knee and swipes this right over the deep square leg boundary. Treating Rashid like a net bowler. He swings his bat in the air after acknowledging the crowd. This one meant something for him!
Trying to hide the ball but it travels too far down leg
And now he's boshed this over covers! He's making this pitch look flat as morning pancakes, at the moment. Was right in the slot outside off, he played the lofted drive with that solid elbow of his
What a ripper from Rashid... Was pitched on a full, great length. Spun away from the left-hander and beat his outside edge
Back of a length. Kohli goes on the back foot and pulls this towards deep square leg

He's killing this chase in a hurry... Still a long way to go, but not if DDP is in this form. This ball was speared in right in the slot, on the stumps. Lofted drive down to long-off, flew off in a hurry
Well outside off, back of a length angled back in slightly. Kohli plays a slightly risky lofted drive, down to covers
Exact same shot, even more conviction, but he hasn't got the elevation this time... Was on the leg-stump line once more. Falls just short of long leg

What an amazing flick, this! Was back of a length, rising right at his hips. He just swivels at this ball and plays this behind him, towards long leg. Almost caresses it on its way, more than anything else
DDP shuffles into the leg side... Prasidh tries to follow him, but ends up lining this up right on his pads. Easy flick runs down to deep fine leg boundary
Prasidh bangs this in short once more. Somehow gets on top of it once more and drives this on the up, towards covers
Back of a length outside off. Kohli steps onto the backfoot and flicks this towards square leg
On a length and he flicks this towards deep square
Now slightly fuller, attacking the pads. Driven down to square leg
Boshes this perfectly ok delivery past covers! On a good length and spinning away from outside off. But Kohli is shuffling into the leg side in a jiffy once more

Long hop and it's Virat 1, Rashid 0! 300th six in the IPL too, for Kohli. Was right on the stumps but dropped too short. Kohli went on the backfoot and had all the time in the world to bang this straight down the ground
Shuffles deep into the leg side as he looks to cut this! On a length, right at the stumps. To point
Deceives Kohli in the air this time, 143 clicks. Was short and well outside off. Kohli can't middle this flick as it dribbles down to mid-wicket
Now it's slightly fuller. He drives this through the covers, again off a very short ball
How did he do that!? Takes on the bounce. The ball rose upto his shoulder, he ran down the pitch. Between point and backward point, perfect glide
Now he rises on the bounce and whacks this to deep extra cover! Stayed deep in the crease. Ball was outside off, he drove this from such a tall connection point

Rushes down the pitch, and he's somehow stolen two here! Was swiped from back of a length, well outside off. Down to deep midwicket, KG is slow running upto the delivery. Kohli makes great use of the extra second to run back
Back of a length and rising at him outside off. Flicked towards deep square
Back of a length but down leg. Flicks this towards deep midwicket
Full-ish and he flicks this towards deep midwicket
Back of a length and loses pace off the pace. Defended down the pitch
Sits on the backfoot, waits for this short ball. Rises at him and he pulls this towards cow corner with panache. Great wrists. Read the slower 'un out of the hand
On a length and he swivel-pulls this towards deep midwicket
French cut! Back of a length outside off. Kohli goes for a big pull but the ball rifles into the pitch and dribbles behind him
He's in diamond touch and you can see why... Outside off, right in the slot. he gets down on one knee and threads a silken lofted drive over the covers
Back of a length and angling away from him outside off once more. DDP goes for a huge swivel but misses this one
He goes for the late dab and misses! The ball was back of a length. Outside off and angled away. Batter misreads the line as he almost edges this to the keeper
Fuller and corrects his line to attack the stumps. Defended right back at him
On a length outside off. Jumps at this once more, dabbed down to covers
Back of a length but straying onto the pads. He jumps at this to get above the ball, and flicked down to deep fine leg
Back of a length and angled away to him outside off. Dabs this towards backward point, happy to get to the other end
Once again. Back of a length and Kohli's happy to dab this towards deep backward point
Back of a length, dabbed to short deep third
Best shot of the night, this. First ball and right on the pads, too full once more. 153 clicks but on this length, DDP just uses it into his lofted flick and shovels it over deep square leg
On a length outside off. He takes the smart option by deadbatting this towards gully with a late glide, then takes off
Whaddaflick, no notes on that one... Washington must be hiding in the field right now. Too full, on the pads, and Kohli flicks those wrists of this to run this down past cow corner

And now Bethell's carved this right to point! Sat up to be hit outside off, in the slot. But he middled this right at the one fielder standing there. He lets out a small scream in agony. Had a big chance in this chase here, and it's slipped him by. For now
Huge swing over midwicket! Back of a length and rising at him. He swipes this across the line and didn't time it perfectly, but didn't need to because it's vacant
Defended down to the bowler. Back of a length and rising at him
Wonderful drive down past point! He shuffles into the leg side to manufacture room and middled this one
On a length outside off, hit towards covers and takes off to the other end
Full and outside off, driven confidently past point
Back of a length, rising at his hips. Hits him on the body and runs down to point
Back of a length and beats him on the swish outside off this time
Kohli's showing why you shouldn't drop him. Back of a length, rising at him and he swipes at this standing well down leg. Over to the long-on boundary with a big swipe
On a length outside off, big outside edge down towards deep backward point
Quite full and defended into the V, towards his left
Whaddaball first up! On a length and swinging away. Gets the inside edge on Bethell's defense, runs down to deep third
Back of a length and rising at his hips down leg once more. Tucked down to fine leg
Back of a length and right outside off. Bunted down to point and he'll jog to the other end
Slightly fuller and on the stumps. Now, Holder messes up a simple fielding effort near deep square leg. They run back for the second

HE'S BEEN DROPPED! Washington Sundar absolutely shells this one at mid-wicket. Was on a length, on the stumps. Kohli goes for the flick and hits it straight at Sundar. Had to do nothing but collect it. Ball bounces out...
On a length but straying down leg. Tucked off his hips towards square leg
On a length outside off. Confident drive but straight to covers
